svg.title: A localized parabolic-band envelope moves and spreads
svg.desc: A normalized Gaussian envelope evolves under the one-dimensional Hamiltonian p squared/(2m*) minus F x, with positive constant m* and external F. The initial center and mean velocity are zero. The initial position standard deviation is Delta x0, t0=2m*Delta x0 squared/hbar and F*t0 squared/(2m*Delta x0)=1. At s=t/t0=0,1,2, the position centers x_c/Delta x0 are 0,1,4 and the widths are sqrt(1+s squared). Dashed lines mark expectation-value centers, not trajectories of individual electrons. The plotted density is the coarse-grained envelope of an isotropic parabolic band.
svg.text: Parabolic-band motion: the packet moves and spreads
Uniform external F > 0 · positive constant mass · zero initial mean velocity
